Describe one indie hacker idea. BVT expands it into ranked offers, landing pages, CTAs, pricing angles, DOM experiments, and deployable receipts so you can test the business instead of hand-editing every variation.

Manual Business Iteration

one offer per loop

idea -> ranked experiments

Measured local release bench: 320,000 typed ops -> 10,000 unified patch artifacts in about 0.22-0.24s, roughly 41k-45k patches/sec. Business claim: this accelerates offer, page, CTA, pricing, and DOM experiment generation; customers, revenue, and retained learning still require real traffic, measurements, rollback, and BVT receipts.
